extraction.name: LAMBADA
extraction.description: A dataset to evaluate the capabilities of computational models for text understanding by means of a word prediction task.
extraction.creator: Denis Papemo, Germán Kruszewski, Angeliki Lazaridou, Quan Ngoc Pham, Raffaella Bernardi, Sandro Pezzelle, Marco Baroni, Gemma Boleda, Raquel Fernández
extraction.publisher: CIMeC - Center for Mind/Brain Sciences, University of Trento, Institute for Logic, Language & Computation, University of Amsterdam
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The LAMBADA data come from the Book Corpus. The corpus, after duplicate removal and filtering out of potentially offensive material with a stop word list, contains 5,325 novels and 465 million words. We randomly divided the novels into equally-sized training and development+testing partitions.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The LAMBADA dataset was filtered to exclude passages that are relatively easy for standard language models.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering out passages that are relatively easy for standard language models, using a combination of four language models to exclude passages whose target word had probability ≥0.00175 according to any of the language models.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human subjects were used to annotate the data through the CrowdFlower crowdsourcing service. For a given passage, one human subject guessed the target word based on the whole passage, a second subject guessed the target word based on the whole passage, and more subjects tried to guess the target word based on the target sentence only, until the word was guessed or the number of unsuccessful guesses reached 10.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The criteria for passage inclusion were very strict: We required two consecutive subjects to exactly match the missing word, and we made sure that no subject (out of ten) was able to provide it based on local context only, even when given 3 guesses.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is designed to encourage the development of new models capable of genuine understanding of broad context in natural language text.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset has a bias towards proper nouns, which account for 48% of the target words.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is challenging for current models, and it is not recommended to use it for developing ad-hoc models only meant to predict the final word in the sort of passages encountered in LAMBADA.
